name: gta-v-2026-05-16-w2400
description: Minutes 40:00-50:00 of the same GTA V session the seed dataset covers at 30:00-40:00. Labelled from contact sheets on a fixed 5-second grid (120 frames), by Claude, before this window was ever analysed by the pipeline -- the labels are out-of-sample by construction. Read from pixels and on-screen text only; the audio was never heard. Five-second sampling means short events between tiles (single gunshots, the instant of a carjack) are inferred from their aftermath and noted as such.

recordings.note: Same cheat-enabled sandbox session as the seed window: the INVINCIBILITY countdown and cheat toasts recur, and one death lands exactly when the countdown runs out. Arc of the window: street shootout -> Coquette carjack -> three-star chase with two police rams -> car wrecked -> rooftop firefight with helicopter and rappelling SWAT -> invincibility expires -> WASTED -> hospital -> on-foot rampage -> truck theft -> four-star freeway run -> bail-out onto a hillside over burning wrecks.

spans.note: Street shootout at 40:05-40:25: muzzle flash, fires and bodies on the street, about two stars.
Three-star police chase in the stolen Coquette from 40:40; police cruisers visible behind and beside.
Police broadside at 41:00 and a second ram at 41:10.
Carjacking the Invetero Coquette at 40:30 straight into the chase and the rams.
Rooftop firefight 42:10-43:15 after the car is wrecked at Playa Vista: bloodied player firing down, about four stars by 42:35.
Police helicopter close with SWAT rappelling at 43:05-43:10. Same labelling call as the seed window's helicopter: the shape of encounter a reel wants.
The rooftop stand: wrecked car to rooftop firefight to helicopter and rappelling SWAT. The strongest stretch of the window's first half.
The INVINCIBILITY countdown runs out on screen ('Cheat deactivated' ~43:50) and the wanted level collects its debt: WASTED within twenty seconds.
WASTED at ~44:10; black by 44:15, Mount Zonah Medical Center sign at 44:20.
Hospital respawn 44:20-44:55: cheat re-activation toasts, weapon wheel, walking out into a dusk street. Nothing contested.
No stars read in the hospital tiles after the death; the row appears hidden.
Post-respawn street attacks 45:00-45:25: a burning motorcycle at 45:15, fleeing pedestrians, stars returning. The attacks themselves fall between sampled tiles; labelled from the aftermath.
Driving the stolen Surano across the city 45:45-46:35. Faint wanted stars, no police in frame; transit.
On-foot rampage 46:40-47:55: bodies on the road at 46:45 and 46:50, aiming at 47:00, $15 looted at 47:15, a burning wreck beside an ambulance 47:35-47:45, firing at a police car at 47:50.
An overturned vehicle burning beside the PARAMEDIC ambulance at 47:45-47:50.
The burning-vehicles stretch of the rampage, police engaged, invincibility re-armed mid-scene ('Cheat activated: Invincible for 5 minutes' ~47:44).
INVINCIBILITY countdown bottom-right from 47:45 to the end of the window: 04:57 at 47:50 down to 02:47 at 49:55.
Four stars from 48:25 through 49:55, truck theft to hillside.
Four-star freeway run in the stolen canopy truck 48:25-49:30: Del Perro Fwy to Vinewood Hills past cones, wrecks and an armoured truck.
The middle of that run is monotone dark freeway with no police in frame; an editor keeps the theft and the bail-out, not the minute between.
Bail-out on the freeway at 49:35, scramble up the hillside, burning wrecks on the lanes below, firing down by 49:50. The window ends mid-standoff.
Firing down at the freeway 49:50-49:55; the fight continues past the window.
